tmsFocus: Retain stimulation frequencies and investigate their possible relevance to auditory brain entrainment. Matching frequency values alone does not demonstrate equivalent mechanisms or effects. Treat transfer as a research question.
specificCorrections: Use approximately 0.1 Hz and Mayer waves in the baroreflex section.

Identify the animal evidence and receptor subunits in the NMDA section.
Preserve the selected IL6 passage reporting changes in both resting controls and the music-making group.
Retain Oxytocin receptor gene (OXTR) is related to psychological resources; remove the retired evolutionary and spiritual framing.
Identify SLC6A4 as a serotonin transporter.
Describe oxytocin and intergroup relationships with their study context, without a universal claim about ending conflict.
